0022600181.text: The Rockets, who are 7-1 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the Timberwolves (5-3, third in the Northwest and one game back) in Houston's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with Houston on a two-game winning streak and Minnesota on a one-game streak. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Rockets lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 136-132 defeat in Houston on April 10, 2026.
